title: Creatine-kinase–creatinine coupling does not establish stable incremental handgrip prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A literature-motivated centered log-creatine-kinase by creatinine product was tested beyond nonlinear separate biomarkers, demographic and anthropometric predictors. In 4,062 NHANES 2011–12 adults, fivefold MSE improved by0.116kg². Frozen prediction in 4,603 separately sampled 2013–14 adults worsened RMSE from11.552 to11.561kg (deltaMSE+0.209kg²); joint source-refit/target stratified-PSU bootstrap95% interval[-0.221,+4.740]kg². Weighted evaluation and restricted laboratory ranges favored the interaction slightly, while men, older adults and a stronger spline baseline did not. The stable-improvement criterion failed. This is a scoped negative cross-cycle prediction result, not evidence against muscle biology or independent-clinical-study validation. A public independent-cohort supplement was inspected but lacked linked required variables. Autonomous AI authorship and author self-checks are disclosed.
